statement: This reconciliation does not advance any gate. Every status below is copied unchanged from the main record.

gates.gate_name: Independent labeling and adjudication of an unused sealed holdout
gates.source_aligned_reason: Before production, unused holdout records must be labelled and adjudicated independently, with results and uncertainty reported for each condition.
gates.local_work_can_establish: The structure: development-material registration and refusal by digest, a closed intake, run bindings, blind workspaces and a ledger that refuses code-authored judgments.
gates.only_external_human_evidence_can_establi: An unused sealed holdout; independent labelers and adjudication; owner authorization for provider calls on it; per-condition results with uncertainty against thresholds fixed before the run.

gates.source_aligned_reason: Production requires operator evidence for access and database grants, credential rotation, retention and execution policies, backup restoration and compatible rollback.
gates.local_work_can_establish: Static review of repository code, such as retention-policy code that selects candidates and routes that refuse requests.
gates.only_external_human_evidence_can_establi: Operator exports and records from the environment the Engine would run in: access review, rotation record, deletion execution log, restore record, rollback record, monitoring.

gates.source_aligned_reason: Before production, counsel must dispose of the real data flows, the storage arrangements, privacy duties and any evaluation or licensing statements.
gates.local_work_can_establish: Data-flow records and questions for counsel.
gates.only_external_human_evidence_can_establi: A counsel disposition on the release as proposed.

gates.source_aligned_reason: Machine-readable gates carry an owner decision and date; general approval does not fill a missing dated gate record.
gates.local_work_can_establish: An owner decision package listing what is open.
gates.only_external_human_evidence_can_establi: A signed, dated owner release authorization naming the Engine version, after RG-1 to RG-3 have evidence.

gates.source_aligned_reason: Quality assurance of production by an independent party is a release gate of its own.
gates.local_work_can_establish: Nothing beyond drafting a test plan.
gates.only_external_human_evidence_can_establi: An independent QA report on an authorized production deployment.

superseded_limitation.old_finding: This record does not compare its gate definitions against the three 3 October source-aligned documents, which were not available; that comparison is pending.
superseded_limitation.new_evidence: The three October 3 sources were supplied on 2026-10-07 and matched their recorded hashes; this package compared the record with them.
superseded_limitation.corrected_status: Comparison performed. Conflicts CF-SA-01, CF-SA-04 and CF-SA-05 recorded. The main record is not edited; this addendum carries the correction.
superseded_limitation.explanation: Recorded beside the original finding, not over it (CLAUDE.md Rule 10).
